detail.longDescription:
@gwadej@mas.to 

I did not go to the YAPC::NA that was in Houston.  ISTR my last YAPC was in 2002, maybe?

#Perl will always be special to me as a FOSS activist because — while the 1992–2002 Perl community *definitely* had serious toxicity problems — I learned there what #FOSS community was about, and how #SoftwareFreedom could make #programming & usage of software egalitarian.

Fascinatingly, I later hung out in the #Python community, & it was much less software-freedom-oriented than Perl's community.
